specs.title: VMware Cloud Foundation as a Service API
IBM Cloud for VMware Solutions API

connections.local_bgp_asn.description: Local network BGP ASN for the connection.

connections.local_gateway_ip.description: Local gateway IP address for the connection.

connections.local_tunnel_ip.description: Local tunnel IP address for the connection.

connections.remote_bgp_asn.description: Remote network BGP ASN for the connection.

connections.remote_gateway_ip.description: Remote gateway IP address for the connection.

connections.remote_tunnel_ip.description: Remote tunnel IP address for the connection.

connections.transit_gateway_connection_n.description: The user-defined name of the connection created on the IBM Transit Gateway.

cpu.description: The vCPU usage limit on the virtual data center (VDC). Supported for VDCs deployed on a multitenant Cloud Director site. This property is required when the resource pool type is reserved.

director_site.id.description: A unique ID for the Cloud Director site.

director_site.pvdc.compute_ha_enabled.description: Specifies whether compute HA is enabled for this VDC.

director_site.pvdc.id.description: A unique ID for the resource pool.

director_site.pvdc.provider_type.name.description: The name of the resource pool type.

fast_provisioning_enabled.description: Indicates whether to enable or not fast provisioning.

name.description: A human readable ID for the virtual data center (VDC). Use a name that is unique to your region.

ram.description: The RAM usage limit on the virtual data center (VDC) in GB (1024^3 bytes). Supported for VDCs deployed on a multitenant Cloud Director site. This property is required when the resource pool type is reserved.

rhel_byol.description: Indicates if the RHEL VMs will be using the license from IBM or the customer will use their own license (BYOL).

windows_byol.description: Indicates if the Microsoft Windows VMs will be using the license from IBM or the customer will use their own license (BYOL).
